lines.text: When trouble shows up, where do you run first? Psalm forty-six.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Be still, and know that I am God. Psalm forty-six, ten.
Run to Him before the phone, before the bank app, before anybody. He answers.
Lord, we run to You. Amen. I'm Derrick Hughes. Have a blessed day.
